authority: pinned public release tag and commit-specific source review with synthetic production-parser replay; the tag is unsigned
scope: Review App Server Thread lineage, attached-thread list semantics, thread listener/resume/unsubscribe lifecycle, and Codex CLI overlap. This is not a complete upstream implementation audit or a live interoperability claim.

decisions.change: Thread now exposes attachedToThreadId as an independent persisted-attachment relation. parentThreadId remains the direct subagent parent; forkedFromId remains the fork source. The three relations have distinct semantics.
decisions.decision: Preserve all fields. Group only by an exact observed parentThreadId or attachedToThreadId edge in the same active Target and consistent session tree. Never infer a parent from sessionId or forkedFromId. Orphan, conflicting, cyclic and cross-session edges remain ungrouped.

decisions.change: The latest protocol adds explicit controls for attached-thread inclusion and lookup. Attached threads remain hidden from ordinary listings unless explicitly requested; includeAttachedThreads is constrained to title search.
decisions.decision: Do not broaden the default Mission Control inventory or add a background attached-thread scan. Keep the current all-known-source request. Project an attached relation only when the authoritative target response actually contains that thread.

decisions.change: The known source-kind set remains cli, vscode, exec, appServer, subAgent, subAgentReview, subAgentCompact, subAgentThreadSpawn, subAgentOther and unknown.
decisions.decision: The existing registry request already includes every known kind and degrades to an explicitly PARTIAL inventory when a target rejects the filter. No source-kind implementation change is required.

decisions.change: The server adds stronger synchronization between cold resume, listener startup, unload and terminal unsubscribe cleanup. thread/unsubscribe retains notLoaded, notSubscribed and unsubscribed statuses.
decisions.decision: Keep explicit per-connection resume, exact request/Thread routing, release cleanup after uncertain outcomes and no automatic reconnect. Treat the internal listener changes as upstream-owned; do not copy their lifecycle implementation.

decisions.surface: Codex CLI native workspace and agent surfaces
decisions.change: Codex CLI 0.171.0 makes the TUI Workspace the default and adds native document/image previews and subagent transcripts; codex agents and codex queue are documented as Stable.
decisions.decision: Keep the local conversation client, Queue UI and embedded terminal maintenance-only. Mission Control remains differentiated by cross-repository/cross-Target discovery, Attention, Forge and derived WorkCard projections; do not recreate native conversation or agent orchestration.

decisions.change: The official App Server remains Experimental.
decisions.decision: Pinned schema/source review and synthetic replay are protocol-shape evidence only. Authenticated real-target L3 and user field acceptance remain NOT QUALIFIED.

remainingQualification: Authenticated real App Server L3, real multi-Target use, and the centralized G1/G2/G3 field acceptance remain NOT QUALIFIED. G4 retirement remains blocked until that acceptance is completed.
